content:
## Task
Improve the post-route quality of `priority32` (32-bit registered priority encoder: index of the highest set bit of a, plus a found flag) without changing its behavior.

## Specification (current RTL, also the equivalence reference)
```verilog
module priority32 (
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst_n,
    input wire valid_i,
    input wire [31:0] a_i,
    input wire [31:0] b_i,
    output reg valid_o,
    output reg [5:0] y_o
);

wire hit_0 = |a_i[31:0];
wire [4:0] idx_0 = a_i[31] ? 5'd31 : a_i[30] ? 5'd30 : a_i[29] ? 5'd29 : a_i[28] ? 5'd28 : a_i[27] ? 5'd27 : a_i[26] ? 5'd26 : a_i[25] ? 5'd25 : a_i[24] ? 5'd24 : a_i[23] ? 5'd23 : a_i[22] ? 5'd22 : a_i[21] ? 5'd21 : a_i[20] ? 5'd20 : a_i[19] ? 5'd19 : a_i[18] ? 5'd18 : a_i[17] ? 5'd17 : a_i[16] ? 5'd16 : a_i[15] ? 5'd15 : a_i[14] ? 5'd14 : a_i[13] ? 5'd13 : a_i[12] ? 5'd12 : a_i[11] ? 5'd11 : a_i[10] ? 5'd10 : a_i[9] ? 5'd9 : a_i[8] ? 5'd8 : a_i[7] ? 5'd7 : a_i[6] ? 5'd6 : a_i[5] ? 5'd5 : a_i[4] ? 5'd4 : a_i[3] ? 5'd3 : a_i[2] ? 5'd2 : a_i[1] ? 5'd1 : a_i[0] ? 5'd0 : 5'd0;

wire [5:0] chosen_0 = hit_0 ? {1'b1, idx_0} : 6'd0;

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
        valid_o <= 1'b0;
        y_o <= 6'd0;
    end else begin
        valid_o <= valid_i;
        if (valid_i)
            y_o <= chosen_0;
    end
end
endmodule
```
Your design must be cycle-for-cycle equivalent to this module from reset: same ports, synchronous active-low reset, `valid_o` follows `valid_i` one cycle later, and `y_o` updates only on valid cycles and holds otherwise.

## Flow and objective
Yosys/ABC synthesis to the Nangate45 library, then OpenROAD placement, clock tree synthesis and routing with a 10 ns clock and a fixed floorplan. Score = 10 * WNS_ns - 0.001 * area_um2, where WNS is the worst setup slack after routing and area is total standard-cell area. Higher is better.

This RTL measured: area 208.81 um^2, WNS 7.64557 ns, score 76.24689.

## Rules
- One module of synthesizable Verilog-2005 (no helper modules or instances; the equivalence checker compares flat modules). The module name and ports must not change.
- No initial blocks, system tasks, compiler directives or technology cells.
- place_and_route budget: 4 submissions. Every submission counts, including failed ones.
- At most 30 tool calls in total.

Tools available: place_and_route, finish. Your score is the best verified place_and_route score. Call finish when you are done.

content.text: I'll restructure the 32-deep priority mux chain into a shallow, balanced tree (group ORs → prefix "any higher group" signals → one-hot group select → direct output bit ORs). Area is nearly free in the score (0.001/µm²) while each ns of delay is worth 10 points, so I optimize purely for logic depth.

Interesting — a completely different (much shallower) structure gave essentially the same WNS (7.633 vs 7.646), so a large fixed term (input delay/slew/setup) dominates, and ABC had already balanced the original chain. Still, ~12 ps swings matter here, so let me push logic depth to the minimum by writing every product as a flat AND of level‑1 literals (avoiding the `g & ~(OR of g)` two-step), which should cut 1–2 gate levels off the critical bits.

Both restructurings landed within ~15 ps of each other (7.6309 / 7.6334 / baseline 7.6456), so gate depth is clearly *not* the limiter — the fixed input-delay/slew term dominates, and the small remaining spread tracks how many gate inputs each `a_i` bit drives (baseline 2 loads/bit → best WNS; mine 3 loads/bit → slightly worse). So my last real lever is minimizing primary-input pin loading while keeping depth low: a pair-based decomposition where every even bit drives exactly 1 gate and every odd bit exactly 2 (48 input loads vs 64 baseline / 72 mine).

Three structural rewrites all came out *below* the baseline WNS (7.6309, 7.6334, 7.5894 vs 7.6456), while area savings (≈10–20 µm², worth ≤0.02 points) can't compensate a 12–55 ps WNS loss (0.12–0.55 points). The critical path is dominated by a fixed input-delay/slew term that ABC already reaches optimally from the original description, and every restructuring only perturbs it for the worse. With one submission left, the expected-value-maximizing move is to lock in the known-best netlist (the reference structure) rather than gamble again.
